blocks.content: Now, let's complete this program by combining all the components we've developed so far.
Congratulations! You've completed the basic program for complex calculation!
As you can see, we first performed a complex number division by 0, followed by complex subtraction.
But thanks to our exception handling, the program prints and error message and exits the program the moment it encounters the illegal division.
Now, we can add further features to our calculator to make it more useful and versatile.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
